name: eskiu-language
description: Eskiu language support: highlighting, live errors, completion, hover with types and signatures, signature help, go to definition, outline, formatting and Run

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In a workspace you have not trusted, Eskiu does not run a compiler the workspace provides: its eskiu.compilerPath, eskiu.compilerFlags and eskiu.entryPoint settings and its build directories are ignored, and the installed eskiuc is used.

eskiu.compilerPath.markdownDescription: Path to `eskiuc`. Empty uses `build22/eskiuc` or `build/eskiuc` in a trusted workspace, else `~/.eskiu/bin/eskiuc`, else `eskiuc` on `PATH`. Set it when the editor does not inherit your shell `PATH`.

eskiu.entryPoint.markdownDescription: The root file of the program (e.g. `src/main.esk`), absolute or relative to a workspace folder or to the file; used for a file it reaches through `import "..."`. Empty: the `main` of the nearest `eskiu.toml`, else the top of the file's importers, else the file alone.

eskiu.compilerFlags.markdownDescription: Extra command-line flags to pass to `eskiuc` (e.g. `["--freestanding"]`, `["-Wall", "-Wno-format"]`). Default-on warnings (`-Wformat`, `-Wstring-compare`, ...) show as warnings; each `-Wno-` flag turns one off.

eskiu.checkOnType.description: Type-check while typing, not only when a file is opened or saved.

eskiu.checkDelay.description: Milliseconds to wait after the last edit before type-checking.
